newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland shortlists advisers in oil sector sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Poland shortlists advisers in oil sector sell-off.

text.p: Poland's state-owned oil firm Nafta Polska SA, overseeing the oil sector's privatisation, has shortlisted five international consortia in a tender for an adviser in the sell-off, the company said on Thursday.

It said in a statement that the tender's winner, due to be chosen in June, would be responsible for financial, economic, legal and environmental studies necessary for the planned public offering of two refineries -- Petrochemia Plock SA and Rafineria Gdansk SA.
The adviser would prepare refineries' privatisation offers, which are to be sent to prospective investors early next year. @
* Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, Business Management & Finance, Muse Stancil, Dames & Moore, Freshfields and Kancelaria Prawnicza Furtek, Palinka, Zielinski
* Goldman Sachs International, Central Europe Trust
* Salomon Brothers International, Creditanstalt Financial Advisers
* Schroder Polska, Hunton & Williams Poland, Price Waterhouse Poland, Purvin & Gertz Inc., WS Atkins Polska.
